steps.content: At last, you arrive at the end of the passage.
A stone chamber opens before you. In its center, a pillar lies toppled, its surface etched with strange, twisting patterns. You recognize the same motifs that marked the base of the shattered sphere.
Since you tracked the trail all the way here from that place, these two structures might once have been a single piece.
Which means what you shattered back there was only the top half...

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: You have already intervened once, and made an attempt to destroy the altar. Yet you were unable to eliminate them entirely.
You force yourself to stay calm. It changes nothing. You'll battle it out once more if you must. Whatever this "ritual" is, you are going to stop it.
[Lichen's portrait]
Lichen stands facing away, her clothes fouled beyond recognition by mud and gore. Her eyes are fixed upward, fixed on her great creation: the enormous, expanding shape of darkness looming ahead.
The thing has grown truly colossal now, its shadow stretching across the ground, all the way to your feet.
You can't see her face. Having finally witnessed this power, what fills her eyes? Pride, envy, or something closer to the fervor of a pilgrim?
She hears your footsteps halt behind her and lets out a soft laugh.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: So you've finally come around? Here to lend me a hand?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: This is your shifu?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Of course not.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Shifu worried herself sick over the Perishing Star. Always worn down, always tired. Could barely walk a few steps without stopping to catch her breath. She never looked anything like this.
She looks down at her palm, and her voice drifts for a split second, almost unmoored, before snapping back into something cold and absolute.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Shifu, or the so-called "Celestial Master," whoever they want to call on... hah.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: When it comes down to it, begging gods and bowing to masters is never going to get you as far as counting on yourself.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Anyway, this is what people believe in. A real "god" is nothing more than mortal faith given shape.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Turn that kind of power against the calamities, and it would be almost too easy.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're trying to harness the Void of Yin, but that power is just going to swallow you whole in the end—

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: That sounds awfully preachy. Who's been filling your head with that?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Nobody told me what to say or do.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I'm standing here because I can't just stand by and watch you keep going down this road.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You use people's faith, but can you even hear what they're really asking for? The last thing they want is to summon a monster.
She lets out a quiet chuckle.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: What they're really asking for...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Two years ago, I went southwest to collect stories about prophetic dreams and walked right into a massive earthquake. I ended up staying for three months.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Anyone with any clout in the area had already cleared out. No help coming from them. But somehow, everyone pinned their hopes on me, just one traveling Daoist. And wouldn't you know it, cheering people up with my little tricks? That's kind of my specialty.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Wooden sword to ward off evil, gourd to cure what ails you. But you know what everyone wanted most? Incense. Any idea why?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What exactly are you trying to say?

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: We'd dig people out of the rubble one by one, and then we'd have to put them back in the ground. But the earth was split wide open. Where was there even room to bury anyone? It was slow enough already with those beat-up shovels and pickaxes, and this was the southwest in July, hottest and muggiest time of the year...
Your stomach lurches. She sees the look on your face and smiles, her reddened eyes locking onto you as she presses the question again.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: So tell me, then. What is it that people really want?
With a sweep of her sleeve, she shows off the immense form looming at her back, her expression verging on proud.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: When you get right down to it, peace and a steady world. Isn't that all anyone ever asks for? So I'll give them exactly that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: With that thing? You think you can control it? You can't even keep these scattered phantoms in check right now.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If it ever breaks out of Maria City, slips free of you, Chengxiao, from everyone's control, it could kill tens of thousands of people in the blink of an eye.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're standing closer to this power than anyone. You have to feel that.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: "Will and longing are born entwined, tethered to form"...

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Sure, you destroyed the pillar. But the principle still holds. A physical anchor can stabilize belief. See? I really am still a woman of "science."

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Something to draw them all together... how hard could that be to find?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: There's nothing here that could—

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: ...without a vessel to bind them, those phantoms will only grow more restless. They will seek out the next tangible form to latch onto.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Such as... a human.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Stop! Don't you—
You launch yourself off the rubble. But she's faster, her hand already raised. Red ribbons whip from her sleeves and streak toward the scattered phantoms, cinching tight around their ghostly forms.
Golden light races along the ribbons, and with every pulse, the outline of the "god" sharpens into greater clarity.
[Monster silhouette appears]
The Benevolent Mother looms above, gazing down upon you both.

Her face is hidden behind copper coins strung together with red threads, and it's precisely this concealment that stirs the imagination: how holy, how radiant must the visage beneath be, surpassing all that human eyes have ever beheld.
It feels as though merely kneeling in devotion, bowing your head, and offering your all would earn her forgiveness for every sin and the granting of every wish.

steps.speaker: Whispers
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Yes... she will grant your every wish...
[Red flash]

steps.speaker: Whispers
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i><b>It... will grant your every wish...

steps.speaker: Whispers
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i><b>All you have to do... is give yourself... to It...
[White flash]

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Heh.
The edge of her mouth tugs upward, and a ghost of a laugh slips out, so faint you almost miss it.
Her fingers carve glowing seals into the air, and crimson-cyan fire roars to life in her hand as she utters the spell to command the specters.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Lord of the abyss, bow your heads and guard my gates!
